reuse.why: Puts the rule in the existing getScheduleAmount and reuses the matcher's getApproxNumberThreshold for the cent-rounded tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the tolerance comes from the shared rules helper.

placement.why: The resolution sits in the right shared function, but it relies on a new { value, op } input shape that none of the five callers (forecast, schedule preview, post, action sync, api-models) builds, since they pass the bare _amount / condition value and the op lives separately in _amountOp.

scope.why: A single branch in getScheduleAmount plus table test rows.

maintainability.why: The new branch is reachable only through an input shape no caller produces, so a maintainer would wrongly think approximate amounts are handled; the op is also typed as a free string and never checked.

one_place.where: the rule is written once in shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount, but the callers in forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites), shared/schedules.ts preview and api-models.ts still pass the bare amount without the condition op, so no code path actually applies it
